explanation: Controlled body 1 converges to the final waypoint (4.09,2.12) and dwells there with speed ~5e-14 (step 2421). At step 2422 its state becomes non-finite. Disabling the controller removes the failure, and shifting the final waypoint by 1m also removes it. Likely cause: the waypoint steering law normalizes the to-target vector (or divides by distance/speed) without guarding the zero-distance case, producing 0/0 -> NaN force/velocity that propagates to position.
